original_dispositions.detail: Direct root snapshot cases fixed on both axes, but mounted subtree render overwrites application validation extent and accepts same invalid candidate.
Guide now documents current load/reload/request/info interfaces and leaves only full showcase for future work.

contract: design section7 precommit validation/current real tree and active render semantics
current_findings.title: Mounted subtree render validates application candidate with the subtree extent
current_findings.counterexample: After successful root snapshot(Max,0) for Row or (0,Max) for Column, submit Prepared candidate with two text children weight1 and matching minimum Max; call render(mountedTextChild,1,1), then repeat root snapshot at original extent.
current_findings.actual: Subtree boundary Applied(1), then root snapshot minimum sum overflow; accepted info candidate/1 and postfalse on both axes.
current_findings.expected: Before a pending global candidate is accepted, validate the actual application tree with its relevant root extent; subtree dimensions must not silently replace the root extent. Reject known invalid candidate and preserve old accepted state/session.
current_findings.remediation: Associate validation dimensions with their render target; keep application-root validation constraints distinct from mounted subtree output dimensions. Close this existing failure across UI commit entry points without reintroducing blanket large-minimum rejection.
current_findings.evidence: raw/run.stdout; probe/src/main.cj; independent normal SDK build0/run0
